name: EH3D-CAM-DEBUGGER
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.4: a library and a command line that read a G-code program with the interpreter of EH3D-CORE-LIBS, work out its time with the acceleration of the machine (an upper bound: every move from rest to rest) and look for what would hurt: a rapid move into the material, a move outside the table or below the lowest Z, a cut with the spindle off or with no feed, a feed above a limit and a head that passes over a clamp. No 3D simulation and no removal of material yet; nothing has been tried on a machine.
